thread_text:
Rina Sato: Hi all  Rina here, first day on Eng-Platform! Laptop arrived but Jamf enrollment link didn't. VPN gives auth error. Who should I ping for SSH/org access and quick repo onboarding? Also, two truths and a lie: 1) I once did a week-long silent retreat, 2) I can juggle five scarves, 3) I lived in Kyoto for 2 years. Which is the lie?

Emmett - eng-platform: Welcome Rina!! 389 I'm your manager. I'll loop in IT and assign a buddy. @Sam will help with repos and SSH. Also we'll do a quick 1:1 later.

Nellie (IT): Hi Rina, Nellie from IT. DM device serial and OS and I'll re-send the Jamf invite and manually approve. For VPN, try reinstalling the client after enrollment.

Rina Sato: macOS Ventura, serial C02RST55555. Jamf not in spam.

Nellie (IT): Resent invite and approved. You should see the enrollment prompt in a few minutes. If VPN still errors, paste the exact message here.

Sam (buddy): Hey Rina  I'm your onboarding buddy. For SSH, run: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "rina.sato@redwood.com"` then paste the pub key in the access form or DM me and I'll add you to the org. I'll walk through the main repos tomorrow.

HR Bot: Reminder 514 - complete benefits enrollment within 72 hours: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding

Rina Sato: Update: Jamf invite arrived and device enrolled  VPN works after re-install. Submitted SSH pub key. Also the lie is juggling five scarves 609. Thanks everyone for the quick help! Excited to be here :rocket:
